arm-circles.name: Arm circles
cues: Arms straight out at shoulder height.
Start with small circles, let them grow.
Reverse direction halfway.

leg-swings.name: Leg swings
cues: Hold a wall for balance.
Swing forward and back, loose and controlled.
Stay tall. Don't let your back round.

hip-circles.name: Hip circles
cues: Hands on hips, feet shoulder-width apart.
Draw big, slow circles with your hips.
Keep your head and shoulders quiet.

worlds-greatest-stretch.name: World's greatest stretch
cues: Step into a deep lunge, back knee off the floor.
Drop your inside elbow toward your front instep.
Rotate and reach that hand to the ceiling. Eyes follow the hand.

bodyweight-squat.name: Bodyweight squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit back and down, chest up, arms forward.
Knees track over toes. Drive up through the whole foot.

band-pull-apart.name: Band pull-apart
cues: Hold the band at chest height, arms straight in front.
Pull it apart until it touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades. Control the return.

rower-stroke.name: Rower stroke
cues: Catch: shins vertical, arms long, lean slightly forward.
Drive: legs first, then lean back, then pull to your lower ribs.
Recovery: arms, body, then legs. The reverse order.
Damper 3–5.

jab.name: Jab
cues: From guard, extend the lead hand straight out.
Turn the fist over at the end of the punch.
Snap it straight back to your face. Rear hand stays on your chin.

cross.name: Cross
cues: Rear hand fires straight down the middle.
Turn the rear hip and pivot on the ball of the rear foot.
Snap back to guard. Lead hand stays up.

one-two.name: The 1-2
cues: Jab, bring it back, then cross.
Breathe out sharply on each punch.
Step in with the jab. Step out after the cross.

dead-bug.name: Dead bug
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, knees over hips.
Press your low back into the floor. Keep it there.
Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg, return, switch sides.

glute-bridge.name: Glute bridge
cues: Feet flat, knees bent, arms at your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Shoulders, hips, and knees in one line. Squeeze, then lower slowly.

side-plank.name: Side plank
cues: Elbow directly under your shoulder, feet stacked.
Lift your hips until your body is one straight line.
Hold. Don't let your hips sag.

hip-flexor-stretch.name: Hip flexor stretch
cues: Half-kneeling, front knee over the ankle.
Squeeze the glute of the down leg and shift your hips forward.
Reach the same-side arm up for more stretch.

hamstring-stretch.name: Standing hamstring stretch
cues: Front heel down, toes up, leg straight.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Stop when you feel it behind the thigh. No bouncing.

open-book.name: Open book
cues: Lie on your side, knees bent at 90°, arms together in front.
Sweep the top arm open to the other side. Eyes follow the hand.
Keep your knees stacked on the floor.

cross-body-shoulder.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
cues: Bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use the other forearm to pull it in gently.
Keep the stretching shoulder down, away from your ear.

wrist-stretch.name: Wrist stretch
cues: Arm straight out in front, palm up.
Gently pull the fingers back with the other hand.
Then flip palm down and pull the back of the hand.

calf-stretch.name: Calf stretch
cues: Hands on the wall, back leg straight.
Press the back heel into the floor.
Lean in until you feel it in the calf.

stance-bounce.name: Stance bounce
cues: Stay in your stance, hands up.
Small, light bounces on the balls of your feet.
Shift forward, back, and side to side without losing the stance shape.

one-one-two.name: The 1-1-2
cues: Double jab: the second jab comes from the same spot, don't pull all the way back.
Then the cross straight down the middle.
Back to guard every time.

lead-hook.name: Lead hook
cues: Elbow up to shoulder height, arm bent about 90 degrees.
Turn the lead hip and pivot on the ball of the lead foot. The punch comes from the turn.
Keep it short. Rear hand stays on your chin.

one-two-three.name: The 1-2-3
cues: Jab, cross, lead hook.
The cross turns you one way, the hook turns you back.
Hands back to guard after the hook. Don't admire your work.

one-two-three-two.name: The 1-2-3-2
cues: Jab, cross, lead hook, cross.
Stay balanced over your feet through all four punches.
Breathe out on every punch. Finish in guard.

slip.name: Slip
cues: Bend slightly at the knees and turn the shoulders to move your head off the center line.
Move just enough for the punch to miss. A few inches.
Eyes stay on the target. Come back to guard ready to punch.

speed-bag.name: Speed bag
cues: Fists at eye level, close to the bag.
Small circles with your fists, hitting in rhythm: rebound, rebound, hit.
Light touches. Rhythm over power.

jump-rope.name: Jump rope
cues: Elbows close to your sides. Turn the rope with your wrists.
Small hops on the balls of your feet, just high enough to clear the rope.
Trip? Reset and keep going. Everybody trips.

push-up.name: Push-up
cues: Hands just outside shoulder-width, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Push the floor away. Hips rise with your chest.
Beginner: hands on a bench. Advanced: clap or deficit.

mountain-climber.name: Mountain climbers
cues: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch fast.
Keep your hips level. Don't bounce your butt up.

plank.name: Plank
cues: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach like you're about to take a punch.
One straight line from head to heels. Don't let the hips sag.

pallof-press.name: Cable Pallof press
pallof-press.view: Front view (cable comes from the side)
cues: Stand side-on to the cable, handle at the middle of your chest.
Press straight out in front of you and hold for a second.
Don't let the cable twist you. That resistance is the exercise.

hanging-knee-raise.name: Hanging knee raise
cues: Hang from the bar with straight arms, shoulders pulled down.
Raise your knees to hip height without swinging.
Lower slowly. Beginner: lying leg raises instead.

bear-crawl.name: Bear crawl
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, knees an inch off the floor.
Move opposite hand and foot together, small steps.
Back flat and hips low the whole way.

med-ball-rotational-throw.name: Med ball rotational throw
cues: Stand side-on to the wall, feet wider than shoulders.
Load the ball at your back hip, then turn hips first, arms last.
Throw hard into the wall and catch it on the rebound.

box-jump.name: Box jump
cues: Quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Explode up, swing the arms, land soft on the box with bent knees.
Stand up tall, then STEP down. Don't jump down.
Beginner: squat jump onto a low box or no box.

trap-bar-deadlift.name: Trap bar deadlift
cues: Stand in the middle of the bar, grip the handles, hips back, chest up.
Push the floor away. Hips and shoulders rise together.
Stand tall and squeeze. Lower by pushing the hips back first.
Beginner: kettlebell deadlift, 3 x 10.

goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell at your chest, elbows down.
Sit down between your heels, chest tall.
Elbows inside the knees at the bottom. Drive up through the whole foot.

db-row.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
cues: Free hand on the bench, back flat, dumbbell hanging straight down.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip, elbow close to your body.
Lower with control. Don't twist your torso to lift it.

split-squat.name: Dumbbell split squat
cues: Long split stance, back heel up, dumbbells at your sides.
Drop the back knee straight down toward the floor.
Front knee stays over the ankle. Drive up through the front foot.

landmine-press.name: Half-kneeling landmine press
cues: Half-kneeling, bar end at your shoulder, back knee down on the same side as the pressing hand.
Press up and forward until your arm is straight.
Squeeze the glute of the down leg. Don't lean back.

kettlebell-swing.name: Kettlebell swing
cues: Hike the bell back between your legs, hips back, flat back.
Snap the hips forward hard. The hips move the bell, not the arms.
Bell floats to chest height. Stand tall, squeeze the glutes, then hike again.

med-ball-slam.name: Med ball slam
cues: Reach the ball overhead, up on your toes.
Slam it into the floor in front of you as hard as you can.
Hinge and squat to pick it up. Don't round your back.

farmer-carry.name: Farmer carry
cues: Heavy weight in each hand, arms straight.
Stand tall, shoulders down and back.
Walk with short, controlled steps. Don't lean or shuffle.

ab-wheel.name: Ab wheel rollout
cues: On your knees, wheel under your shoulders, stomach braced.
Roll out slowly as far as you can without your low back sagging.
Pull back with your stomach, not your arms.
Beginner: short range. Advanced: from standing.

pogo-hops.name: Pogo hops
cues: Stay on the balls of your feet with your legs nearly straight.
Bounce off the floor quickly, like the ground is hot.
Short contact, small height. Springs in the ankles.

skater-bounds.name: Lateral skater bounds
cues: Push off one leg and bound sideways.
Land soft on the other leg and hold the landing for a second.
Knee over toes on the landing. Swing the arms for balance.

hollow-hold.name: Hollow hold
cues: Lie on your back, low back pressed into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs just off the floor, arms overhead.
Hold the banana shape. Beginner: bend the knees (tuck hold).

bicycle-crunch.name: Bicycle crunch
cues: Hands behind your head, shoulders off the floor.
Bring one knee in as you turn the opposite elbow toward it.
Extend the other leg long and switch. Slow and controlled.

bird-dog.name: Bird dog
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your back.
Hold for a second without tipping. Return and switch.

doorway-chest-stretch.name: Doorway chest stretch
cues: Forearm on the door frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through the doorway until you feel it across your chest.
Keep your shoulder down. Breathe.

lat-stretch.name: Lat stretch
cues: Hands on a bench, counter, or rail about waist height.
Walk back and sit your hips back, arms straight.
Let your chest drop between your arms. Feel it along your sides.

quad-stretch.name: Standing quad stretch
cues: Stand tall, hand on a wall for balance.
Pull one heel toward your glute, knees together.
Squeeze the glute of that leg to deepen it. Don't arch your back.

figure-four-stretch.name: Figure-4 glute stretch
cues: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Grab behind the bottom thigh and pull it toward your chest.
Keep your head down and breathe into the hip.

cat-cow.name: Cat-cow
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Cat: round your back up, tuck your chin.
Cow: let your belly drop, lift your chest and eyes. Move with your breath.

hip-90-90.name: 90/90 hip switch
cues: Sit tall with both knees bent at 90 degrees, both to one side.
Lift the knees and rotate them over to the other side.
Hands behind you for support at first. Stay tall.

foam-roll-upper-back.name: Foam roll: upper back
cues: Roller under your upper back, hands behind your head, hips up.
Roll slowly from mid-back to the top of your shoulder blades.
Pause on tight spots and breathe. Stay off your low back.
